words.prose: {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the ayah as a governing negative, not a loose refusal. Its force stretches across the inserted grace phrase to the final bā-marked predicate, so the clause denies an identity-class: the addressed person is not to be placed in the charged category. The long opening also makes the ayah begin as rebuttal, and at the boundary with 68:1 it supplies the sworn-upon answer that the preceding oath was waiting for.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence support {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a governing negative in a single negated nominal predication, with the second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) marking the predicate.

topics.headline: negation spans the inserted grace phrase

topics.reason: The clause is one negated predication, and the causal phrase remains syntactically tied to the rejected predicate under that negation.

topics.headline: the denial rejects a charged identity

topics.reason: The predicate is the charged label {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}), and the verbless nominal frame denies classification.

topics.headline: the long opening begins the rebuttal audibly

topics.reason: The written long {{ar:آ}} ({{tr:ā}}) in {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) supports the acoustic observation without changing the grammar.

words.prose: {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) fixes the denial on one directly addressed person. The independent pronoun stands as the nominal subject before the final predicate appears, keeping the addressee visible while the grace phrase interrupts the route to the accusation. Across the boundary from 68:1, the scene contracts from an unnamed plural writing frame to a singular personal vindication.

topics.headline: independent pronoun singles out the addressee

topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) as an independent second-person singular pronoun, and attachment evidence resolves it as the single direct addressee.

words.prose: The first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) opens the middle grace phrase and governs {{ar:نِعْمَةِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}). Locally it functions as a real preposition: grace is the ground, accompanying condition, or means by which the charge is excluded, with the oath-like reading remaining a solemnizing possibility rather than the governing parse. As a bound proclitic, the short particle is visibly fused to the grace noun and releases into its nasal texture, so the middle phrase is heard and seen as one governed unit. Because the same form returns before {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}) with a different job, this first particle makes the ayah's two {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) forms visibly comparable but grammatically distinct.

topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) as the preposition governing {{ar:نِعْمَةِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}), attached as the causal phrase in the predication.

topics.headline: the proclitic visibly binds grammar to grace

topics.reason: The surface phrase writes the preposition as a proclitic attached to the grace noun, and the phonetic observation supports the same local unit.

words.prose: {{ar:نِعْمَةِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}) is the genitive grace noun governed by the first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) and bound in construct to {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}). That grammar makes the favor specific, relational, and operative against the predicate, not a loose abstraction. Its root field adds well-being, ease, bestowed favor, and even concrete provision; locally those branches are narrowed into the grace that counters the charged claim of covered or disturbed reason. The singular construct form compresses many possible favors into one possessed state, while the variant and derivational evidence keep the act of bestowal audible behind the main reading. Within the surah, this root later returns in reward and rescue contexts (68:34; 68:49), and it also recalls the broader blessed-path formula (1:7).

words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) completes the grace phrase by naming whose favor is operative. The suffix {{ar:كَ}} ({{tr:ka}}) makes the title definite and personal, binding the same addressee named by {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) into the source of the denial. The root range adds ownership, authority, nurture, repair, completion, and cultivation, but local grammar selects one singular Lord-relation as the source of {{ar:نِعْمَةِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}), not a plural or competitive lordship field. That nurture and cultivation give the title a developmental pressure against the accusation of cognitive diminishment. Its placement delays the final accusation so that lordly nurture is heard immediately before the denied predicate, and the doubled center of the title creates a compact stop before the suffix resumes the addressee. Later same-surah uses keep this Lord-relation in view around reward, command, and rescue (68:34; 68:48; 68:49).

topics.reason: QAC marks {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) as a noun with a second-person suffix, and attachment evidence treats the suffix as the possessive complement.

topics.reason: The possessive suffix refers to the same single direct addressee as {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}), linking subject identity and divine relation.

topics.headline: genitive possessor also names the bestowing source

topics.reason: V4 accepts lordship and nurture/completion branches for {{ar:ر ب ب}} ({{tr:r-b-b}}); the local noun selects the Lord-title while allowing nurture and cultivation to shape the payoff.

words.prose: The second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the predicate-reinforcing particle before {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}). Unlike the first {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), it does not add a new lexical relation; it diagnoses and strengthens the governing {{ar:مَآ}} ({{tr:mā}}) construction. Bound to the predicate noun, it makes the final label visibly dependent on the negation rather than free-standing, and it opens the last beat where the accusation is named only as denied. The brief particle is acoustically absorbed into the nasal-heavy predicate it reinforces.

words.prose: {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}) is the final predicate, formally genitive because of the reinforcing {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) but functionally the label denied of {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}). Its indefiniteness and tanwīn make the exclusion class-wide: the addressee is not any member of that charged category. As a passive participle, the word frames the accusation as an affected condition, with the supposed hidden agent left unstated. The root {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}) supplies covering and concealment, including hidden beings, garden-cover, protective cover, and veiled mind; locally those branches are narrowed to the polemical claim of possessed or covered reason. That makes the grace and Lord phrase directly antithetical to externally imposed veiling. The final word concentrates nasal sounds and tanwīn at the closure, so the charged label lands densely while still being grammatically neutralized. The same root later moves within the surah between garden imagery and accusation (68:34; 68:51), while the broader accusation formula recurs in other passages (15:6; 26:27; 37:36; 44:14; 51:39; 52:29; 54:9; 68:51; 81:22).

topics.headline: indefinite predicate excludes the whole class

topics.reason: The surface is singular indefinite with tanwīn under negation, making the classifying predicate broadly excluded.

topics.headline: genitive case serves the emphatic predicate frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader separates the word's genitive surface from its predicate role in the clause.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}) as the predicate of {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}), while the second {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) governs its genitive form.

topics.headline: the clause denies identity, not an episode
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word complete a suspended identity judgment already controlled by the opening negation.
topics.reason: The ayah is a negated nominal predication, so the final predicate completes a denied classification.

topics.headline: covering becomes a denied veiling of reason
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the madness charge as a claim that reason is covered or veiled, not merely as a flat clinical label.
topics.reason: V4 accepts covering/concealment and madness-veiling branches for {{ar:ج ن ن}} ({{tr:j-n-n}}); the local passive participle selects the accused veiled-reason sense while preserving the root image.

topics.headline: garden, shield, hidden being, fetus, and cover stay as family pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the root's many covering domains sharpen the local accusation while not replacing the selected predicate sense.
topics.reason: The broader branches are valid lexical family evidence, but local syntax and form select {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}) as the denied accusation rather than garden, fetus, or shield.

topics.headline: passive participle casts the accused as acted upon
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the denied charge imagines the addressee as a patient affected by an outside hidden force.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the local form as a passive participle pattern, and the root's hidden-being branch explains why possession pressure is plausible.

topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pressure of an unstated cause or hidden agent without turning the surface into a causative verb.
topics.reason: The supplied causative and hidden-being derivatives support the accusation field, but the local word remains a passive participle noun.

topics.headline: the accusation lands only as denied
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the charged final word as the clause's landing point while grammar keeps it neutralized by negation.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah, is bound to the reinforcing particle, and remains indefinite under the opening negation.

topics.headline: {{ar:مَجْنُون}} ({{tr:majnūn}}) belongs to accusation formula and same-surah inversion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this local denial participates in a recurring accusation formula while this surah also flips the same root toward garden imagery.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete references to same-surah forms and a cross-surah accusation list, and the contextual profile supports this form's common use in quoted accusation settings.

topics.headline: grace and lordship answer veiled possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the middle grace-source phrase directly oppose the final image of imposed concealedness.
topics.reason: The local phrase places {{ar:نِعْمَةِ}} ({{tr:niʿmati}}) and {{ar:رَبِّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbika}}) before the denied {{ar:مَجْنُونٍۢ}} ({{tr:majnūnin}}), matching the supplied root-pair opposition.

topics.headline: nasal closure and inscription boundary intensify the defense

topics.reason: The sound rows are locally grounded in the final word's consonants, and the boundary row gives a concrete relation to the inscription frame in 68:1.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The parallel phrases بنعمة ربك and بمجنون place the Lord's favor beside the negated state of majnun.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowed good is carried through a relation of lordly repair and nurture, while madness is imaged as a veil over reason. The verse therefore grounds cognitive integrity in ongoing care rather than offering an unsupported self-defense.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the positive condition in the first bi-phrase and makes the denial rest on received good rather than self-certification.
Repair, nurture, and completion make 'your Lord' an active formative relation through which the favor sustains the addressee.
Madness as a veil over reason supplies the exact cognitive covering denied by the second bi-phrase.

changed_reading.before: A bare reassurance that the addressee is not insane.
changed_reading.after: The negation is relationally grounded: the Lord's favoring, completing care is incompatible with the veiling of reason named by majnun.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The second-person negation is interrupted by the possessive authority marker ربك and by نعمة before the charge مجنون is named.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage a conflict of classifications. A branch of نعم activates praise, lordship supplies authority, and the covering field of جنن makes the accusation something laid over a person; the verse removes that imposed classification while preserving the literal denial of madness.

activation_trace.role: Praise as excellent activates an evaluative edge within the favor word and functions as the positive appraisal opposed to the accusation.
Lordship, ownership, and authority supply the standing from which the counter-verdict is issued.
Covering and concealment give the public label material force as something that can obscure the person it purports to describe.
The mind-veiling branch keeps the counter-classification anchored in the ordinary charge of madness rather than dissolving it into a generic social theme.

changed_reading.before: Madness is denied as though it were a private clinical description.
changed_reading.after: The verse is also an authorized removal of a covering public verdict: the addressee stands under his Lord's favor and appraisal, not under the accusers' imposed class.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pen and ordered writing externalize durable speech; the great inward disposition supplies continuity of character; mutual seeing, the question of al-maftun, and divine knowing turn the rival classifications into an assay whose result unfolds. The focus denial thus opens an evidentiary process rather than ending discussion by assertion.

activation_trace.role: The veil-over-reason image states the cognition charge that the following evidence will test.
The pared writing reed supplies inscription and functions as an external record against which coherence can be examined.
The aligned written row supplies ordered text and makes the utterance visibly structured rather than mentally scattered.
Inward disposition supplies a stable character witness and joins textual order to durable agency.
Physical seeing supplies the promised reciprocal observation and makes the rival claims answerable to what becomes manifest.
The assay of metal or person turns al-maftun into a test that separates soundness from defect.
Loss of reason or property keeps the competing mental-disorder sense live inside that assay instead of sanitizing the accusation.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies the final epistemic horizon in which the tested difference is uncovered.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:1 and 68:4-7 move from inscription to disposition to future mutual sight, then explicitly ask which party is al-maftun.
The focus negation precedes rather than replaces this staged disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inscription, inward disposition, sight, assay, a mind-loss branch, and repeated knowing; I supply the arrow that durable output and conduct function as public evidence against the label. A live alternative is that these are parallel assurances without a single evidentiary chain.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks the hearer simply to accept a denial of madness.
changed_reading.after: The denial announces a testable claim: ordered revelation, sustained character, and coming perception will disclose which side actually bears disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context profiles falsification, reciprocal smoothing, fault-finding, tale-bearing, and fabricated attribution before threatening a mark on the snout. Within that speech ecology, majnun becomes a stigma deployed to cover a person and move listeners, not a neutral report of observed illness; the sequence reverses the mark onto the marker.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the material analogy for a stigma that obscures its target.
Mind-veiling supplies the literal content weaponized by the social label.
Attributing falsehood to a thing or its bearer supplies the practice of discrediting a speaker by classification.
Soft accommodation and dissimulation supply the desired reciprocal coating of differences and show speech being managed strategically.
Faulting and attacking people supplies the hostile evaluative act into which the madness charge fits.
Speech carried out as malicious report supplies the transmission mechanism by which a stigma circulates.
Saying what was not or attributing it supplies an explicit branch for manufactured verbal classification.
The nose or snout supplies the bodily site of the returned public mark and completes the reversal from stigmatizing to being stigmatized.

structural_cues: The branchless root و س م at 68:16 is used only as the structural cue of marking; no branch identity is assigned to it.
The catalogue of speech practices in 68:8-15 culminates immediately in the bodily marking scene of 68:16.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies false attribution, dissimulation, faulting, tale-bearing, manufactured saying, and the uncited structural act of marking; I infer that majnun operates within this system as stigma. A live alternative is that the catalogue condemns the opponents generally without specifying the production of this particular label.

changed_reading.before: The verse corrects a sincere but mistaken diagnosis.
changed_reading.after: The verse unmasks a deliberate social technology of covering and discrediting; the accusers' label is itself evidence about their speech practice, and the marking is reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden narrative restages all three focus roots: a jannah is a tree-covered enclosure, its cultivated yield is treated as privately controllable, its owners become lost and deprived, and only then acknowledge their Lord; the arc ends with gardens of ease. This makes the focus a compact relation among gift, lordship, and covering: enclosure remains blessing when held under lordship, but possessive closure can itself veil judgment.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the gift whose right relation is later dramatized materially.
Lordship and ownership supply the governing relation that prevents a received good from being treated as autonomous possession.
The veil-over-reason branch supplies the cognitive enclosure whose denial is being re-explained.
The tree-covered garden materializes covering as a productive enclosure and lets the focus root move from diagnosis into economy and ecology.
Sowing and cultivation supply the labor-and-yield mechanism through which the enclosed gift becomes something the owners claim to control.
Straying from guidance or intended direction supplies the owners' first cognitive reading of the ruined garden and echoes the disputed soundness of judgment.
Deprivation and failure to obtain the desired yield expose the gift as non-autonomous and break the owners' closed claim.
Acknowledged lordship re-enters after loss and functions as the repaired ownership relation.
Easeful living supplies the arc's restored garden-state and distinguishes received delight from possessive closure.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:17-34 form a sequence of enclosed garden, secret exclusion, failed recognition, deprivation, mutual blame, repentance, and promised gardens of ease.
The sequence repeats the focus roots ج ن ن, ر ب ب, and ن ع م in a material narrative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the three-root recurrence and the ordered garden failure; I supply the arrow that refusal to hold bounty under lordship turns physical enclosure into a model of covered judgment. A live alternative is that the root recurrence links scenes poetically without making possession a cause of cognitive covering.

changed_reading.before: Favor merely serves as proof that madness is absent.
changed_reading.after: The verse names a right relation among gift, Lord, and cover: acknowledged lordly bounty keeps the recipient from the enclosed judgment later dramatized by the garden owners.

context_deltas.mechanism: The interrogative sequence asks what authorizes judgment: a studied writing, binding oaths, a guarantor, partners, truth, or access to the hidden. Applied back to majnun, the accusation is an adverse ruling about an inward state whose speakers cannot produce record, warrant, or access; the focus counter-verdict therefore wins not only by authority but by exposing the rival verdict's missing basis.

activation_trace.role: Lordship and authority supply the focus verse's positive jurisdiction.
Veiling of reason supplies the inward condition over which the opponents presume to rule.
Judgment between people supplies the forensic frame and turns the charge into a verdict requiring grounds.
Written establishment that imposes judgment supplies the kind of binding record the accusers do not possess.
Following a book through reading and retention supplies the examination needed to claim textual warrant.
The oath supplies a binding guarantee and sharpens the question of whether any enduring authorization exists.
Speech without certainty supplies the precise epistemic weakness of an unsupported madness claim.
Truthful speech supplies the explicit verification condition against which the claimants are challenged.
What is hidden from eyes supplies the inaccessible domain the accusers implicitly claim to know.
Joining letters into writing supplies the imagined record of hidden knowledge and exposes its absence.

structural_cues: Ayat 68:35-41 repeatedly interrogate comparison, judgment, book, study, oath, guarantor, partners, and truth.
Ayah 68:47 closes the warrant problem by pairing possession of the hidden with writing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained audit of verdicts and their warrants; I apply that audit backward to the inward-state allegation in 68:2 and infer that it lacks jurisdiction and evidence. A live alternative is that the questions concern eschatological entitlement only, with no backward legal force on the madness charge.

changed_reading.before: The Lord's word simply outranks the opponents' word.
changed_reading.after: The opponents' diagnosis collapses under the surah's own evidentiary questions: they have neither record, guarantee, truthful proof, nor access to the hidden mind they classify.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fish-companion sequence gives نعمة من ربه a counterfactual mechanics: favor catches a constricted caller before he is cast into exposed space while blameworthy, after which his Lord selects him and makes him sound. The near repetition of the focus phrase concretizes favor as timely interception, protection from stigmatized exposure, and formative restoration.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the focus condition whose operation the later counterfactual makes visible.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the formative agency latent in the focus possessive phrase.
Mind-veiling supplies the stigmatized condition from which the focus addressee is distinguished.
A blocked outlet after fullness supplies the constricted interior state from which the fish-companion calls.
Catching up and reaching supplies the temporal interception by which favor arrives before the threatened outcome.
The repeated bestowed-favor branch identifies the intercepting agent-condition with the focus noun.
The repeated nurturing Lord branch ties rescue to the same formative relation named in the focus.
Throwing and casting supply the averted expulsion and make favor an interruption of trajectory.
Open space without cover supplies the averted exposure and creates a sharp cover-versus-bare contrast with جنن.
Blame and fault supply the averted stigmatized status, linking rescue from exposure to rescue from adverse naming.
Selection and drawing near supply the positive reversal of being cast away.
Soundness opposed to corruption supplies the completed state produced after rescue.

structural_cues: Ayah 68:49 explicitly orders a counterfactual: without favor reaching him, casting into bare space while blamed would have followed.
Ayah 68:50 immediately reverses casting into selection and blame into made soundness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the explicit counterfactual, the near-repeated نعمة/رب phrase, and the rescue-to-selection sequence; I infer that this later event specifies how lordly favor can underwrite the focus denial. A live alternative is that the fish-companion is only a warning contrast and does not explain the favor of 68:2.

changed_reading.before: Favor is an undefined honor attached to the denial of madness.
changed_reading.after: Favor has event-shape: it reaches before expulsion, blocks bare and blame-laden exposure, draws near, and completes soundness; the focus denial carries that rescuing and rehabilitating force.

context_deltas.mechanism: At the close, the opponents hear the reminder, nearly make the addressee slip from his station with their eyes, and then say the exact madness charge; the next ayah reclassifies the utterance as reminder. Hearing triggers hostile seeing and verbal naming, so majnun functions within an attempted displacement rather than as the result of neutral perception. The covering branches of both كفر and جنن also permit a projection reading: those covering truth place a mind-cover over the speaker.

activation_trace.role: The mind-veiling branch supplies the original charge that returns verbatim in the closing scene.
Covering the truth supplies the opponents' perceptual stance and enables the projection reversal without replacing the ordinary sense of disbelief.
Slipping something from its station on an unstable surface supplies the attempted physical and social displacement.
Eye-sight supplies the hostile instrument aimed at displacement, reversing sight from evidence into pressure.
Auditory perception supplies the triggering encounter with the reminder and precedes the hostile gaze and label.
That which makes one remember supplies the actual function of the heard utterance that provokes the attack.
Saying what was not or attributing it supplies the performative act by which the madness label is attached.
The repeated mind-veiling branch closes the ring and identifies the exact accusation as part of the displacement scene.
The repeated reminder branch supplies the immediate counter-classification of the allegedly mad utterance.

structural_cues: Ayah 68:51 orders hearing, hostile gaze, attempted slipping, and the spoken phrase إنه لمجنون in one scene.
The exact focus charge returns near the end and is answered immediately by وما هو إلا ذكر in 68:52.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered perception-displacement-label sequence and the reminder correction; I supply the causal arrow that the label participates in the attempt to unseat the addressee. A live alternative is that hostile gaze and verbal accusation are parallel reactions rather than one coordinated mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Majnun describes what the opponents think they see in the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Majnun is a verbal projectile launched after hearing a disruptive reminder: it tries to move the speaker from his station, while the closing correction reveals the utterance as remembrance rather than mind-veiling.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the shield and garden branches do not give the lexical sense of مجنون here. It remains anchored because the same focus root explicitly carries mind-veiling and protective-cover branches, while the context materializes garden-cover and repeats favor as rescue. Render it only as a root-image reversal: one cover is negated while another protects, never as a claim that majnun literally means shielded or gardened.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places favor directly against a passive-form word from a root whose inventory includes both harmful mind-covering and protective covering.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favor supplies the positive medium in which protection can be imagined.
Madness veiling reason supplies the harmful cover explicitly negated.
The protective shield supplies the opposite-valence cover and enables the contained reversal.
The tree-covered garden gives the root a visibly life-bearing enclosure in the same surah.
Repeated favor as the condition averting exposed casting supplies the later protective action.

changed_reading.before: The addressee is simply not covered by madness.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained root imagery, harmful cognitive cover is negated while favor supplies a protective, life-bearing cover around the addressee.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant mapped ر ب و target under the focus root ر ب ب and pairs it with a branch-distant 'adding further' image from نعم. It remains packet-valid through the explicit split mapping and the later رب/selection/making-sound sequence. Downstream prose should present it as a secondary developmental resonance, not replace the ordinary meaning of rabb or the direct denial of madness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The words نعمة ربك stand between the addressee and the negated mind-veiling, allowing the packet's increase and nurture branches to activate a trajectory rather than a static status.

activation_trace.role: Adding and carrying an act further supplies a developmental edge within the favor word.
The non-dominant mapped branch of nourishment and growing up supplies ongoing formation rather than static patronage.
Mind-veiling supplies the fixed adverse state that the developmental reading refuses to let define the addressee.
The repeated non-dominant nourishment branch carries the growth resonance into the later sequence of divine action.
Selection and drawing near supply a directed transition rather than a mere reversal of label.
Fitness or suitability supplies the attained condition toward which nurture and selection move.

changed_reading.before: The verse defends a fixed mental status at one moment.
changed_reading.after: As a secondary split-root resonance, the verse protects an ongoing trajectory of favoring growth: lordly nurture carries the addressee toward fitness, so a hostile label cannot freeze the process into mind-veiling.

strongest_changes: Inscription, character, sight, and assay turn the focus denial into an inspectable claim whose truth unfolds.
The speech catalogue and marking reversal make majnun a circulated stigma rather than a neutral diagnosis.
The garden arc reuses all three focus roots to model how gift, lordship, and covering can preserve or distort judgment.
The counterfactual نعمة من ربه scene gives favor concrete mechanics: reaching before casting, averting bare blame, selecting, and making sound.
The closing repetition makes the charge part of an attempted displacement provoked by hearing reminder, then immediately reclassifies the utterance as reminder.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact نعمة/رب/جنن relation is not merely echoed but repeatedly operationalized across textual evidence, social labeling, garden economy, forensic warrant, rescue, and the closing gaze-and-speech scene. These mechanisms support coexisting epistemic, social, material, legal, and protective readings without forcing one synthesis.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal force assigned to the first bi-phrase is plausible but stronger than a purely circumstantial or emphatic reading.
The garden model depends on an inferred arrow from possessive exclusion to covered judgment; the packet guarantees recurrence and sequence, not that causality.
The protective-cover and split-root growth readings are deliberately branch-distant and should remain qualified secondary activations.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Nurture prevents mental veiling.** `ن ع م B001` supplies bestowed favor, `ر ب ب B002` repair and stagewise nurture, and `ج ن ن B006` madness as a veil over mind. The two *bi-* constructions oppose the means by which the addressee stands to the alleged condition. I infer nurture -> preservation of discernment; the denial therefore says that the Lord's active formation, not merely an unexplained exemption, contradicts the charge of madness.
2. **Hiddenness put on trial by signs.** `ج ن ن B001/B010` adds concealment and hidden inward state. Later ayat repeatedly move between visible marks (`و س م B001/B002`), seeing (`ب ص ر B001/B002`), and hidden knowledge (`غ ي ب B001`). I infer that an accusation about an inaccessible mind must be tested by outwardly ordered evidence; the ayah reads as a rejection of a concealed-state allegation through the visible coherence of what follows.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:49 repeats *niʿmah min rabbihi* as an intervention that prevents a blameworthy outcome, making the opening favor concretely protective. 68:51 then repeats the madness charge after hearing the reminder, revealing that the accusation describes the hearers' failed compliance more than the addressee's mind.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Lordly favor as sustained formation.** Fixed `رَبِّكَ` activates `ر ب ب B002` (repair, nurture, and completion), and 68:4 supplies the resulting `خُلُق` while 68:5 promises that it will become perceptible. The packet supplies nurture, character, and later sight; I infer a developmental arrow from the Lord's care to a formed moral disposition. The denial of madness thus rests on an ongoing process of cultivation, not only on a bare negation.
2. **One cover displaces another.** Fixed `مَجْنُون` activates both `ج ن ن B006` (mind-veiling madness) and `ج ن ن B001` (covering and concealment); fixed `نِعْمَة` activates `ن ع م B013` (an eye-gladdening favor), which 68:5's doubled sight sharpens. The packet supplies an alleged cognitive cover, favor, and eventual seeing; I infer that favor removes the public and perceptual cover imposed by the accusation. The ayah reads as a contest between disabling concealment and a favor that will make the truth visible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 68:5's doubled sight sharpened fixed `نِعْمَة` through `ن ع م B013`: favor became eye-gladdening reversal of an obscuring accusation. 68:7 then corrected the locus of diagnosis by assigning discrimination to the Lord's knowledge.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Covers Regulate Access to Sight and Interior Truth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Seeing and knowing depend on whether a physical, mental, or social cover protects, obscures, or reveals what lies within.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The charge of madness is reframed as an argument about covered interiors: eye-films, shields, shelters, ribs, and unspoken thought all test what observers can legitimately infer.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: A Covered Mind and an Unspoken Interior
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Thought and disposition are enclosed inside the chest; madness is imagined as the mind being covered or lost, while interior speech remains unvoiced.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: concealment from sense (`quranic:root_000266:B001/m01`); mind covered by madness (`quranic:root_000266:B006/m01`); hidden heart or inward matter (`quranic:root_000266:B010/m01`); reason or property lost in derangement (`quranic:root_001128:B007/m01`); speech held in the mind (`quranic:root_001272:B012/m01`); inward disposition (`quranic:root_000434:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The accusation “mad” purports to read an inaccessible interior. The branch imagery instead distinguishes hidden thought, durable disposition, and a mind overtaken by derangement, preventing those states from collapsing into one polemical label.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: protective shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m01`); hiding-place (`quranic:root_000266:B017/m01`); worn armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m01`); tent-like insect screen (`quranic:root_001315:B006/m01`); leather shelter or groundsheet (`quranic:root_000156:B004/m01`); leather saddle-cover (`quranic:root_001128:B008/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler moves on foot across edges and uneven ground; fatigue, bodily weakness, or reliance on companions alters the gait.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: deliberate walking (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); running (`quranic:root_000993:B002/m01`); bank or side of a route (`quranic:root_000993:B009/m01`); hard uneven ground (`quranic:root_000993:B010/m01`); travel on foot (`quranic:root_001525:B012/m01`); supported swaying walk (`quranic:root_001583:B008/m01`); calm, composed gait (`quranic:root_001583:B010/m01`); exhaustion of walker or mount (`quranic:root_001315:B001/m01`); body worn down by use (`quranic:root_001453:B005/m01`).

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Shield, cutting weapon, spear-part, and heavy tool produce capture; authority may then release the captive without ransom.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: shield (`quranic:root_000266:B008/m02`); armor (`quranic:root_000121:B005/m02`); sword-cut or butcher’s blade (`quranic:root_000704:B004/m01`); pared spear-tip or shaft (`quranic:root_001252:B005/m01`); crowbar or heavy club (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m01`); release of a captive without exchange (`quranic:root_001449:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The martial scene keeps protection, violence, custody, and release distinct. Its unexpected pressure on “uninterrupted reward” is that `م ن ن` can also name the sovereign interruption of captivity without a compensating payment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Wealth and sons are not static possessions; lexical scenes show provision moving through wages, gifts, marriage, livestock, and care, or failing through blocked hands and depleted stores.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Favor Moves as Reward, Gift, and Nurture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A benefactor gives a useful good, a caretaker grows it over time, and recompense returns value for work without exhausting the source.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: favor and good condition (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); ease and comfortable living (`quranic:root_001525:B002/m01`); delight to the eye (`quranic:root_001525:B013/m01`); favor that can burden its recipient (`quranic:root_001449:B003/m01`); nurturing benefaction (`quranic:root_000532:B016/m01`); desired beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`); generosity and gift (`quranic:root_000452:B005/m01`); recompense or wage (`quranic:root_000015:B001/m01`); visible traces of prosperity (`quranic:root_000497:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 68:2 `نِعْمَةِ` [ن ع م] and `رَبِّ` [ر ب ب]; 68:3 `أَجْرًا` [ء ج ر] and `مَمْنُونٍ` [م ن ن]; 68:9 `تُدْهِنُ` [د ه ن]; 68:12 `خَيْرِ` [خ ي ر].
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Favor is a flow joining giver, work, recipient, and visible result. The branch contrast inside `م ن ن` adds a precise risk: a gift can sustain, or its verbal recounting can crush the recipient and undo the social good.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Provision Builds Households or Is Arrested at the Hand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material good becomes socially meaningful through giving, nurturing, earning, withholding, and household reproduction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affiliation Distinguishes Household Member, Ally, and Attached Outsider
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A populous group organizes around a leader and kin; alliance can attach outsiders, but distance of lineage and visible tagging preserve status differences.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tagged outsider (`quranic:root_000647:B002/m03`); distant kin (`quranic:root_000131:B005/m01`); alliance (`quranic:root_000349:B002/m02`); assembled tribal groups (`quranic:root_000532:B004/m01`); herd as social aggregate (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m01`); mass of people (`quranic:root_000266:B013/m01`); regional chief (`quranic:root_001272:B004/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Belonging is not one relation. Kinship, pact, leadership, mass membership, and annexed outsider status are distinguishable mechanisms, which prevents the social portrait in 68:10-14 from becoming a generic list of insults.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Assay Exposes Formation and Moral Texture
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Pressure reveals whether a formed thing is sound, rough, delayed, brittle, or fit for its intended work.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Character is treated like material under assay: measured before formation, tested by fire or ordeal, and disclosed through hardness, lag, excess, and capacity for repair.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Pride Hardens; Repair Restores Fit
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Self-magnification and head-raised anger harden a person against correction, while repair, exchange, and selection restore useful form.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: arrogant self-enlargement (`quranic:root_001029:B006/m01`); angry raised-head pride (`quranic:root_000404:B004/m02`); imposing judgment on another (`quranic:root_001272:B010/m01`); nurture and repair (`quranic:root_000532:B002/m02`); material or practical repair (`quranic:root_001119:B001/m01`); transformation or replacement (`quranic:root_001119:B003/m01`); selected excellence (`quranic:root_000452:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Pride is a deformation of magnitude into self-hardening. The counter-process is not mere condemnation but correction: tend, repair, exchange the damaged state, and select what is genuinely fit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Cloud and Falling Water Mark the Ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Layered cloud persists, rain descends between sky and earth, and the first seasonal water inscribes the soil with growth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: layered rain-cloud (`quranic:root_000532:B008/m01`); abundant gathered water (`quranic:root_000532:B013/m01`); downward release of cloud and rain (`quranic:root_000672:B004/m01`); rain suspended between cloud and earth (`quranic:root_000672:B005/m01`); first rain marking earth with plants (`quranic:root_001650:B003/m01`); light wetting rain (`quranic:root_000497:B003/m01`); gentle moist wind (`quranic:root_001525:B009/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rain functions like the pericope’s writing and branding: it descends and leaves a readable mark. Cloud persistence, falling water, moist wind, and newly signed ground form a complete meteorological process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Covered Garden, Grain Ear, and Aromatic Growth
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water drives enclosing vegetation upward; grain extends into ears, low plants spread, and aromatic growth announces itself by scent.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); dense rising vegetation (`quranic:root_000266:B011/m01`); persistent green plant (`quranic:root_000532:B012/m01`); extended grain ear (`quranic:root_000672:B008/m01`); low salt plant (`quranic:root_001252:B007/m01`); halfa grass (`quranic:root_000349:B005/m01`); aromatic plant disclosed by smell (`quranic:root_001557:B004/m01`); summer browse after spring (`quranic:root_000993:B011/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The scene is a succession of plant forms rather than a generic “nature” motif. Enclosure, upward density, earing grain, low browse, and scent each mark a different stage or mode by which provision occupies the land.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Rain Materializes Provision in Soil, Plant, and Herd
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Provision becomes visible through a water-driven sequence from cloud and rain to marked earth, vegetation, stored water, and animal yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The abstract vocabulary of favor is grounded in an ecology whose failures are equally specific: insufficient rain, dry basins, weak milk, and wandering livestock.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Herd, Milk, and the Risk of Depletion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A herd is maintained through recent birth, watering, milking, and pasture; shortage appears as low milk, weak issue, or a stray animal outside ownership.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: recently delivered milk-animal (`quranic:root_000532:B009/m01`); herd of cattle or camels (`quranic:root_000532:B014/m02`); livestock wealth (`quranic:root_001525:B005/m01`); milking camels at the chest (`quranic:root_001453:B004/m01`); low milk and weakness (`quranic:root_000497:B006/m02`); scant reproductive fluid (`quranic:root_001453:B006/m02`); ownerless stray camel (`quranic:root_000913:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The herd makes wealth biologically contingent. Birth, milk, pasture, and ownership must remain aligned; weakness, low yield, or straying breaks the sequence by which living assets reproduce provision.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: [P1 68:1-16] Fitted Parts Make Shelters, Implements, and Cuts
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Material becomes functional by cutting, joining, tensioning, or arranging parts into a load-bearing whole.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The writing tool belongs to a larger craft world of stitched leather, tent frames, bows, lots, clubs, and terminal cuts; “whole” and “part” are physical operations before they become discourse categories.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lot-Arrows and Game-Sticks Turn Cut Wood into Decision
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pared shafts are collected in a container, cast as lots, or used as striking sticks, turning shaped wood into an instrument of selection or play.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lot-arrow (`quranic:root_001252:B004/m01`); hide container holding arrows (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); stick for striking a game-piece (`quranic:root_001272:B008/m01`); heavy levering tool (`quranic:root_000980:B003/m02`); carrying implement (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m02`); saddle timber (`quranic:root_001029:B009/m02`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Cutting does not predetermine use. The same shaped wood can write, strike, lever, or enter a lot, so material preparation precedes a social decision about the implement’s operation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iyi ve rahat yaşama durumunu, kişiye ulaşan bağış ve iyiliği ve iyiliğin başkasına ulaştırılması eylemini birlikte destekler.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin rahat, iyi ve elverişli bir yaşam durumunda bulunması; ayrıca bir yararın bağış, yardım ya da iyilik olarak ona ulaşması veya başkasına ulaştırılmasıdır.

Birine verilen bağış, yapılan iyilik veya yararın o kişiye ulaştırılması.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, iyi ve rahat yaşam durumunu bunun kişiye verilen yarar ve başkasına ulaştırılan iyilik yönleriyle bir arada gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi olumlu cevap, söyleneni doğrulama ve geleceğe dönük söz verme işlevlerini aynı cevap kolunda açıkça birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu cevap işlevi övgü bildiren eş biçimli koldan ve genel doğruluk inancından ayrıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tek başına kullanılan olumlu cevap ile birine olumlu cevap verme yapısı korunur, övgü anlamı içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir soruya olumlu cevap vermek, söylenen bir şeyi doğru diye onaylamak veya istenen bir iş için olumlu söz vermektir.

facets.statement: Soruya veya önermeye olumlu cevap verip onu doğrulama.
Gelecekte yapılacak bir iş için olumlu söz veya güvence verme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, bu cevap sözünün olumsuz cevabın karşıtı olduğunu ve soru yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinde kullanıldığını ortak biçimde gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: evet diyerek onaylamak veya söz vermek
concept_gloss.applicability: Olumlu cevap, doğrulama ve olumlu güvence verme işlevlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu yanıtlama, doğrulama ve söz verme işlevlerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Olumlu cevap verilen veya bir önermenin doğrulandığı konuşmalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu cevap ve doğrulama işlevini doğrudan korur.
error_profile.loses: Gelecekte yapılacak iş için açıkça söz verme yönünü zorunlu olarak göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir isteğe olumlu karşılık verilip geleceğe dönük güvence sunulduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Olumlu söz ve işi yapma güvencesi yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir önermeyi yalnızca doğru diye onaylama işlevini kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soru yanıtlamanın yanında olumlu söz ve güvence verme işlevini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle geleceğe ilişkin bir bildirimi doğru diye kabul eden cevap sözüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da konuşmada söyleneni doğru sayan olumlu cevap verir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol doğrulayıcı cevapta yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise genel olumlu yanıtın yanında söz verme işlevine de sahiptir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Olumlu soruyu veya bildirimi onaylar ve gerektiğinde söz verme işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Olumsuz kurulmuş sözü geri çevirerek karşıt olumlu hükmü doğrular.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da konuşmada olumlu hüküm kuran kısa cevap sözleridir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel onay ve olumlu yanıt verir; komşu kol özellikle önceki olumsuzluğu bozup tersini doğrular.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların hepsi değerlendirildi; genel olumlu cevap ile doğrulayıcı ve olumsuzluğu bozan cevap türleri arasındaki iki sınır seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه نعم حرفا أو كلمة جواب، للتصديق والإيجاب والعدة، وما اتصل بذلك مثل أنعم له أي قال له نعم.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه نعم المدحية المقابلة لبئس، ولا النعمة بمعنى الإحسان.
branches.source_phrase_ar: نعم جواب الواجب ضد لا (maqayis)؛ نعم عدة وتصديق وجواب الاستفهام (sihah)؛ نعم يكون تصديقا ويكون عدة (tahdhib)؛ نعم كلمة للإيجاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tekil kullanımın özellikle develeri gösterdiğini, çoğul kapsamın ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanlara genişlediğini belirtir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Deveye özgü dar kapsam ile daha geniş otlayan evcil hayvan topluluğu aynı düzeyde genellenmemelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın hayvan adlarını kapsar ve başka kollardaki kuş ya da bağış anlamlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Dar kullanımda develeri, daha geniş topluluk adında ise deve, sığır ve koyun gibi otlayan evcil hayvanları gösteren hayvan varlığıdır.

facets.statement: Dar ve belirgin kullanımda develer veya deve malı.
Geniş topluluk adında deve, sığır ve koyunu kapsayan otlayan evcil hayvanlar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dar adın deveye özgü veya ağırlıklı olduğunu; geniş adın ise deve, sığır ve koyunla birlikte otlayan evcil hayvanları kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.text: develer ve geniş anlamda otlayan evcil hayvanlar
concept_gloss.applicability: Deveye özgü dar kullanım ile daha geniş hayvan topluluğu kullanımını ayırarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Deve odağını ve deve, sığır, koyuna genişleyen topluluk kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dar adın özellikle deve varlığını gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dar kapsamdaki deveye özgü hayvan adını korur.
error_profile.loses: Geniş adın sığır ve koyunu da kapsayan topluluk yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve, sığır ve koyunun birlikte kapsandığı geniş kullanımlarda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geniş topluluk kapsamını ve hayvanların otlayan evcil türler oluşunu korur.
error_profile.adds: Bağlam sınırlandırılmazsa kaynak kapsamı dışındaki başka otlayan evcil türleri de düşündürebilir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geniş kullanımda sığır ve koyunu da deveyle aynı hayvan topluluğuna katar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ergin erkek deveyi, devenin eşini ve develerin sahipleriyle birlikte oluşturduğu sürüyü ayrıntılandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da develeri ve deve varlığını doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol dar adla deveyi, geniş adla birkaç evcil hayvan türünü kapsar; komşu kol devenin cinsiyet, erginlik ve sürü ayrıntılarına odaklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Deveyi merkez alır ve geniş kullanımda sığır ile koyunu birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnız koyun ve keçi türünden küçükbaş hayvan topluluğunu cinsiyet ayrımı yapmadan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol evcil ve otlayan hayvanların topluluk adları alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol deve merkezli olup daha geniş bir tür dizisine açılır; komşu kol küçükbaş hayvanlarla sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar tarandı; deve merkezli dar kapsam ile sürü ve küçükbaş topluluğu arasındaki iki karşılaştırma sınırı en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعم والأنعام، خصوصا الإبل، وبالتوسيع الإبل والبقر والغنم والبهائم الراعية حيث نصت المصادر على ذلك.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعمة بمعنى العطاء، ولا النعام الطائر، ولا النعامة المشبهة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعم الإبل لما فيه من الخير والنعمة والأنعام البهائم (maqayis)؛ النعم واحد الأنعام وهي المال الراعية وأكثر ما يقع هذا الاسم على الإبل (sihah)؛ النعم لم يريدوا بها إلا الإبل فإذا قالوا الأنعام أرادوا بها الإبل والبقر والغنم (tahdhib)؛ النعم مختص بالإبل وجمعه أنعام (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kuş türünde birleşir; ancak tekil ve topluluk adlarının erkek, dişi veya türün bütünü için kullanılışı konusunda kapsam farkı bildirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tür kimliği sabittir, fakat tekil biçimin cinsiyet kapsamı kaynaklardaki farklı kullanımlara göre belirtilmelidir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan kuş türüne aittir; benzetmeyle adlandırılan nesneler ve deyimler bu kola katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devekuşu türüdür; kullanılan biçime ve kaynağa göre türün bütünü, erkek veya dişi birey gösterilebilir.

facets.statement: Doğrudan devekuşu türü ve bu türün bireyi.
Tekil ve topluluk adlarının erkek, dişi veya tür geneli için kullanılabilmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt kuş türünde birleşir; ayrım, tekil ve topluluk biçimlerinin tür geneli ile erkek veya dişi bireye nasıl dağıtıldığı noktadadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kuş türünün kendisini karşılar; cinsiyet ayrımı gerektiğinde bağlamla belirlenir.

error_profile.preserves: Tür kimliğini korur ve tek başına zorunlu bir cinsiyet ayrımı eklemez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir cinsiyetten çok kuş türünün bütünü kastedildiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kuşun tür kimliğini açık ve doğal biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Bazı kullanımlardaki özel erkek veya dişi birey ayrımını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Canlı kuş türünü ve onun erkek ya da dişi bireylerini doğrudan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kuşa benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği nesne, beden bölümü, yol ve gök konumlarını gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Komşu koldaki aktarmalı adlandırmaların benzetme kaynağı bu kuşun görünüşüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol gerçek kuşu adlandırır; komşu kol kuşun görünüşünden hareketle başka varlıklara aktarılmış adları toplar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Türü veya tek bir erkek ya da dişi bireyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir arada bulunan devekuşlarının oluşturduğu sürüyü özel bir topluluk adıyla gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kolun canlı katılımcısı aynı kuş türüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol tür ve birey düzeyindedir; komşu kol ise yalnız birden çok bireyin oluşturduğu sürü düzeyindedir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm aday kuş ve kuşla ilişkili adlar değerlendirildi; gerçek türü aktarmalı adlardan ve sürü adından ayıran iki karşılaştırma seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه النعامة والنعام للطائر المعروف، ذكرا أو أنثى، وما يذكر من جنسه وصفاته المباشرة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعم الإبل، ولا الأجسام أو الأمثال المسماة نعامة بالتشبيه إلا إذا كان الطائر نفسه مقصودا.
branches.source_phrase_ar: النعامة معروفة لنعمة ريشها (maqayis)؛ النعامة من الطير يذكر ويؤنث والنعام اسم جنس (sihah)؛ النعام الظليم والنعامة الأنثى (tahdhib)؛ النعامة سميت تشبيها بالنعم في الخلقة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi devekuşuna benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği çeşitli varlıkları destekler; bunlar tek bir nesne türü değil, ortak adlandırma yoluyla bağlı bir kümedir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Benzetme ilişkisi korunmalı, listedeki nesnelerden bağımsız ve üretken bir genel anlam çıkarılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimlerin aktarmalı adları tanımlanır; gerçek kuş ve kuşlu deyimler bu kapsama alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Devekuşunun görünüşüne veya belirgin bir özelliğine benzetilerek aynı adın verildiği kuyu kirişi, dağ gölgeliği, ayak ya da bacak bölümü, yol ve Ay'ın konak yerleri gibi varlıklardır.

facets.statement: Devekuşuna benzerlik yoluyla başka bir varlığa aktarılan ad.
Kuyu kirişi, dağ gölgeliği, ayak veya bacak bölümü ve yol için kullanılan aktarmalı adlar.
Ay'ın konak yerlerinden biri veya bu adla anılan yıldız kümesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, kuşun görünüşünden doğan ad aktarımını kuyu ve dağ yapıları, beden bölümleri, yol ve gök konumu gibi farklı somut örneklerle gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ortak benzetme kaynağını koruyarak farklı aktarmalı adların tümüne uygulanır.

error_profile.preserves: Gerçek kuştan başka varlıklara yapılan ad aktarımını ve örnek çeşitliliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyu, dağ, beden veya yol üzerindeki somut benzetme açıklanırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Görünüş benzerliğine dayalı somut ad aktarımını korur.
error_profile.loses: Ay'ın konak yeri olarak kullanılan özel gökbilim adını açıkça kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: devekuşuna benzetilen kuyu kirişi, gölgelik, beden bölümü veya yol

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kuşun adıyla anılan kuyu, dağ, beden, yol ve gök konumu gibi aktarmalı varlıkları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı devekuşu türünü ve onun bireylerini doğrudan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aktarmalı adların ortak benzetme kaynağı komşu koldaki gerçek kuştur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol benzerlik yoluyla başka varlıklara verilen adlardan oluşur; komşu kol ise benzetme kaynağı olan canlı türün kendisidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ad aktarımında kaynak görüntü olarak devekuşunu kullanır ve gök konumuna kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Ad aktarımında kaynak görüntü olarak böbreğin biçimini kullanır ve kap, yay ile bulut parçalarına yönelir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol bir varlığın görünüşünü başka nesnelere ad olarak aktarma yolunu kullanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Adlandırma yöntemi benzerdir, fakat benzetme kaynağı ve ad verilen nesneler bütünüyle ayrıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı değerlendirildi; gerçek kuşla sınır ve başka bir benzetmeli ad kümesiyle yöntem farkı en yararlı iki karşılaştırmadır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المسميات المشبهة بالنعامة في الهيئة أو البعد أو السرعة، مثل خشبة البئر والظلة على رأس الجبل وباطن القدم أو عرق الرجل أو الساق والمحجة والنعائم من منازل القمر.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الطائر نفسه، ولا الإبل والأنعام، ولا نعم الجواب والمدح.
branches.source_phrase_ar: على معنى التشبيه النعامة وهي كالظلة تجعل على رءوس الجبل (maqayis)؛ النعامة الخشبة المعترضة على الزرنوقين والنعائم منزل من منازل القمر (sihah)؛ النعامة الخشبة المعترضة على الزرنوقين وابن النعامة عرق الرجل ومحجة الطريق (tahdhib)؛ النعامة المظلة في الجبل وعلى رأس البئر تشبيها بالنعامة في الهيئة والنعائم من منازل القمر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi belirli kuş imgeli sözlerin topluluğun dağılması, hızla ayrılması, yol alması, birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesi için kullanıldığını destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız verilen söz kalıplarına aittir; kuşun tek başına taşıdığı yalın bir dağılma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kanıtlanan söz kalıplarına bağlanır ve yalın kuş adına dağılma ya da yenilme anlamı yüklemez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kuş imgeli sözlerde bir topluluğun hızla dağılıp ayrılması, yol alması veya birliğini ya da gücünü yitirmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir topluluğun bir arada kalamayarak dağılıp ayrılması veya yola çıkması.
Topluluğun ortak sözünü, gücünü veya saygınlığını yitirmesi.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, kalıplaşmış kuş imgesini toplu ayrılma ve dağılma çekirdeğine bağlar; hızla yol alma, ortaklığın bozulması ve güç kaybı bu çekirdeğin bağlamsal sonuçlarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kanıtlanan kuş imgeli sözlerdeki dağılma, ayrılma ve güç kaybı alanını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Toplu dağılmayı, ayrılmayı ve buna bağlı güç kaybını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Topluluğun birliğini kaybedip farklı yönlere ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Topluluğun dağılması ve ortaklığının bozulması yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Hızlı yol alma kullanımını zorunlu olarak belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dağılmanın yanında ayrılma, hızla yol alma ve güç kaybı sonuçlarını taşıyabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle insanların birbirinden farklı yönlere saçılmasını tek bir tarihsel benzetmeyle anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir topluluğun birlikten çıkıp farklı yönlere dağılmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu kol yönlere saçılma üzerinde yoğunlaşır; bu kol ise belirli kuş imgeli yapılarda ayrılma ve güç kaybını da kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; farklı yönlere dağılma karşılaştırması kalıbın ayrılma ve güç kaybı sınırını açıklar.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه شالت نعامتهم وخفت نعامتهم وأضحوا نعاما ونحوها، حيث يدل التعبير على الارتحال أو التفرق أو ذهاب العز أو الهزيمة.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه النعامة الطائر إذا لم تكن في مثل أو كناية، ولا أسماء الأجسام المسماة نعامة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: شالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقوا (maqayis)؛ للقوم إذا ارتحلوا أو تفرقوا قد شالت نعامتهم (sihah)؛ خفت نعامتهم أي استمر بهم السير وشالت نعامتهم إذا تفرقت كلمتهم أو ذهب عزهم (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı güneyden esen, yumuşak, nemli ve öteki rüzgarlara göre daha ıslak bir yel için ortak biçimde kullanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Yumuşak esiş tek başına yeterli değildir; güney yönü ve nemlilik bu kolun belirleyici sınırlarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın rüzgar adına aittir ve genel yumuşaklık ya da kuş anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Güneyden esen, esişi yumuşak ve taşıdığı hava nemli olan rüzgardır.

facets.statement: Güney yönünden esen belirli bir rüzgar.
Esişi yumuşak, havası nemli ve ıslaklık taşıyan rüzgar niteliği.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt rüzgarın güney yönünü, yumuşak esişini ve belirgin nemliliğini aynı hava olayı içinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yön, esiş biçimi ve nemlilik koşullarının üçünü de açıkça karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Güney yönünü, yumuşak esişi ve nemli hava niteliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Rüzgarın yönü ile yumuşak ve nemli hissi birlikte anlatıldığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güney yönünü ve yumuşak, nemli esiş niteliğini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Güney rüzgarının yumuşak esişini ve belirgin nemliliğini zorunlu özellik olarak taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Güney rüzgarının esmesi, kişiye ulaşması ve onunla ilişkili bulut gibi daha geniş olayları kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da güney yönünden gelen rüzgarı doğrudan gösterir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol genel güney rüzgarının yumuşak ve nemli bir türüdür; komşu kol yönü koruyup esiş niteliğini sınırlamaz.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.

error_profile.preserves: Sahiplik, üstün yetke ve yönetim çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Adın hiçbir bağlı unsur olmadan mutlak kullanıldığı inanç bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Mutlak kullanımın yalnız Tanrı'yı göstermesi sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ev, hayvan veya başka bir varlık üzerinde sahiplik ve yönetim bildiren tamlamalarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirtilen şey üzerindeki sahiplik ve yönetim ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Tapınılan nesne ve yükselme çağrışımı komşu dalın ek alanıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin sahibi, yöneticisi veya üstün konumdaki varlığı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme sahiplik ve üstünlük alanındadır; odak dal kullanımın mutlak ya da tamlamalı oluşunu ve düzenleyici yönetimi sınırlar, komşu dal ise tapınma nesnesine ve yükselme çağrışımına da açılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan bilgi sahipliğini değil, Tanrı bilgisi, dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dinî bilgiyi Tanrı bilgisi, bilgelik ve öğreticilikle genişletir; komşu dal ise özellikle dinî hukuk bilgisinde uzmanlaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan topluluğu anlamı, yalnız herhangi bir çoğulluğu değil büyük sayı veya fiilî birleşme niteliğini taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan büyük insan topluluğu ve birleşmiş kabileler alanında kalır; hayvan sürüsü anlamı bu dala genellenmez.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar binlerce kişilik toplulukları, on bin kişilik bir sayıyı ve birleşmiş kabileleri büyük sayı ile toplanma ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıda insanın ya da birleşmiş kabilelerin oluşturduğu topluluğu genel olarak anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.
